$comment: The canonical framework specification commit SPEC.md is generated from (trustoverip/dtgwg-trust-tasks-spec). Moved only by a pull request — .github/workflows/framework-spec-bump.yml opens one when canonical main moves, via `npm run bump-framework-spec` — so trusttasks.org serves only text reviewed here. `ref` is the branch or tag the commit was taken from, shown in SPEC.md's banner. Never edit `commit` without regenerating SPEC.md: `npm run check-framework-spec` fails until they agree.
